description: Personal portfolio website with resume and blog functionality

resume-data-loader.purpose: Loads and manages resume data from JSON storage
resume-data-loader.notes: Pure static data loading, no external dependencies. Single source of truth: the only atom that knows the resume data source

pdf-generator.purpose: Generates PDF resume from loaded data using client-side library
pdf-generator.notes: Uses local pdfmake 0.2.10, works entirely in browser; receives ResumeDataLoader via constructor | +++===+++ 2026-11-05 Asia/Baku — Hasan Alizada — ATS layout; CV variants via cv_profiles

blog-renderer.purpose: Renders blog articles from markdown files in articles folder
blog-renderer.notes: Static markdown processing, permanent URLs for articles

seo-optimizer.purpose: Manages SEO metadata, structured data, and social media tags
seo-optimizer.notes: Schema.org markup for professional profile, Open Graph tags

ui-components.purpose: Provides reusable UI components with modern minimalistic design
ui-components.notes: Apple-inspired minimalistic design, white background, black fonts

navigation-handler.purpose: Handles page navigation and URL routing for single-page application
navigation-handler.notes: Hash-based routing for GitHub Pages compatibility

arcade.purpose: Architecture-themed mini games on the blog page while there are no articles
arcade.notes: Canvas only, no libraries; loaded on demand by App.mountArcade; pauses off screen

dependencies.lib_notes: All external libraries are vendored locally (not CDN)

build_targets.cv_pages: cv/<profile>/index.html — generated by tools/build-cv-pages.js from cv_profiles (noindex, not in sitemap)
build_targets.static_blocks: GENERATED:* blocks in index.html and article.html — tools/build-static.js (SEO tags, JSON-LD, header brand, menu, footer) from data/resume.json
build_targets.cv_hub: cv/index.html — private page with buttons per CV role, primitive passcode set by tools/set-cv-passcode.js (hash only; not security); built by tools/build-cv-pages.js
build_targets.site_pages: work/, services/, privacy/ index.html — tools/build-pages.js and tools/lib/site-pages.js from site_pages in data/resume.json; Services switch: to_render; Work appears when it has items
build_targets.consent: assets/js/consent.js — cookie banner and GA4 loader, shared by all pages
build_targets.build_all: node tools/build.js — build-static, build-articles, build-pages, build-cv-pages
build_targets.check_all: node tools/check-site.js — links, canonical, sitemap, no phone, switches, generated files up to date
